Name: Modest Maps Wilderness Farm
Author: InkubusMods
Description:
[b][u]::  OVERVIEW ::  [/u][/b]
The Modest Wilderness Map is a redesigned Wilderness Farm, meant to capitalize on the space provided by the vanilla map, while adding a few tweaks here and there for A more clean and OCD-Friendly workspace.
[u]
[b]::  FEATURES ::  [/b][/u]
[list]
[*]A [u]backyard[/u] with ample space!
[*]A pond in the lower left corner for refilling water far from the trough, as well as a great crab pot farm, and spot for ducks to swim.
[*]Cliffs have been cleaned and cut for more space and a [u]cleaner modernized ascetic[/u].
[*]Shrine, pet bowl, and totem spawn [u]moved close[/u]r for easier access.
[*]A [u]chance to catch mountain fish[/u] in the large pond.
[/list]
[b][b][u][u]::  REQUIRES ::  [/u][/u]
[/b][list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b]
[*][b]Yep.[i] That's all.[/i][/b]
[/list][/b]
[b]MANUAL INSTALLATION:[/b]
[b]1. Download the file.[/b]
[b]2. Extract the Folder.[/b]
[b]3. Put said folder into:[/b]
[b] ﻿Steam>Steamapps>Common>StardewValley>Mods.[/b]
[b]4. Load with SMAPI.[/b]
[b]5. Enjoy.[/b]
[b][b]
[/b][u]::  KNOWN ISSUES::[/u]
Check Nexus bug reports. If you've found something not there, please post it and I will try to assist.
[/b]
